scenes.event: Miles attends a community volunteer fair.
scenes.description: Miles walks through the volunteer fair, which is filled with booths from local churches, shelters, and community groups. He is drawn to a booth offering spiritual mentorship and career guidance for young adults. Alice and Yan Qianqian, both volunteering at the event, approach him.

characters.name: Miles Owens
characters.description: A 26-year-old man in a simple t-shirt and jeans, carrying a Hillsong playlist in his phone, looking thoughtful and introspective.; 26-year-old, Male, seeking new direction in life, 24 years old; Occupation: Recently submitted resume to Canadian Tire, in career transition; Personality: Hopeful, Thoughtful, Devout, Independent; Values: Faith, Self-reflection, Inner Peace; Interests: Worship Music, Spiritual Growth, Career Development; Experiences: Recent job applications, Life transition period, Personal worship practices, Friendship with Yan Qianqian, Seeking spiritual connection

characters.name: Alice Chen
characters.description: Alice Chen; Female; Age: 27; Occupation: Career Counselor and Part-Time Volunteer Coordinator; Personality: Empathetic, supportive, observant; Values: Personal growth, community service, integrity; Interests: Mentoring young adults, spiritual development, networking; Experiences: Worked with at-risk youth in career transition programs, volunteered at a local homeless shelter during college, recently co-founded a career mentorship initiative at the community center.

characters.name: Yan Qianqian
characters.description: A 25-year-old community volunteer and Miles' friend, with a warm and observant personality; Female; Age: 25; Occupation: Social worker in training at a local non-profit organization; Personality: Empathetic, analytical, encouraging; Values: Compassion, personal growth, community empowerment; Interests: Spiritual discussions, mentoring youth, urban gardening; Experiences: Organized a neighborhood tutoring program, volunteered at a homeless shelter during college, led a small group for career development at a youth outreach center.

actions.dialogue: Hey Miles! I didn’t expect to see you here. You usually prefer your quiet worship time at home, right?
Yeah, I usually do. But I’m in a transition period, and I thought maybe I could find some direction here. I’ve been thinking about how my faith and career can align.
That’s great, Miles! I’ve been helping out with this booth, and we actually have some programs that focus on spiritual growth and career development. You might find it interesting.
Spiritual growth and career development? That sounds like exactly what I need. I’ve been applying for jobs, but I feel like I need more clarity on what I’m really meant to do.

actions.action: Smiles and gestures to the booth
actions.dialogue: Then this is the place to start. Yan can walk you through the details. I think it would be good for you to connect with others too, even while staying true to your personal journey.
Let me show you what we have. It’s all about helping people like you find purpose through faith and community. You don’t have to do everything alone, you know.

scenes.plot: Miles is at a volunteer fair, seeking ways to align his spiritual growth with his career development. His friends Alice and Yan Qianqian approach him and guide him to a booth that offers mentorship in both areas, challenging him to consider community involvement as part of his journey.
scenes.social_purpose: To showcase Miles' values of faith and self-reflection, his personality of being thoughtful and independent, and his current experiences of career transition and seeking spiritual connection, while introducing him to a potential new path through social interaction.
